raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With a compressed-tensors `pack-quantized` int4 checkpoint whose `lm_head` is quantized (a `config_groups` entry with `targets: [lm_head]`), the target model serves normally but DFLASH exits on the first request:

```
File ".../srt/models/dflash.py", line 124, in candidate_topk
RuntimeError: DFlash candidate top-k requires a dense FP16/BF16/FP32 target lm_head or a supported lm_head.quant_method.
```

Startup already hints at it: `DFLASH draft greedy head kept eager (reason=unsupported quantized lm_head).`

`should_apply_lm_head_quant_method` (`layers/logits_processor.py`) decides whether the target logits path and the DFLASH candidate selector call `quant_method.apply`. It required `hasattr(lm_head, "weight")`, but the method owns its parameter layout: the WNA16 (Marlin) linear method stores its codes in `weight_packed`, GGUF in `qweight`. So the helper returned `False` for a head whose `apply` works, `dflash_worker_v2.py` kept the draft head eager, and `models/dflash.py::candidate_topk` raised.

Reproduced on v0.5.21 and current `main` with Qwen3.8-27B W4A16 (int4 group-128 head, `lm_head` added to the config group and removed from `ignore`) + `incoai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2` on one RTX 4090.

## Modifications

- `should_apply_lm_head_quant_method`: gate on the method only (`None`, no callable `apply`, or a known unquantized method → `False`). The `weight` reads stay where they are needed, in the ModelOpt stale-method layout checks, which return `False` for a head without `weight`.
- `LogitsProcessor._compute_lm_head`: require `weight` before taking the helper's branch, so heads without `weight` (GGUF, packed codes) keep the existing fp32-aware `apply` path. The target logits path is unchanged for every head.
- Only the live definition is touched. The file also carries a dead copy of this helper and of `_has_lm_head_runtime_attrs` near the top, pasted back by the Qwen3.8 rebase (#35758) above the originals from #27906 / #34158; Python keeps the later definitions. Removing it is a behavior-free deletion I can send as a separate PR if wanted.

Behavior change, intended: a head without `weight` paired with a non-ModelOpt quantized method is now admitted by the DFLASH selector (previously refused, then crashed). The compressed-tensors WNA16 case has been run end to end; GGUF / GPTQ / AWQ heads take the same path but were not exercised. DSPARK is unaffected (its worker requires `lm_head.weight` before this helper is reached).

Tests:
- `test/registered/unit/spec/test_dflash_logits.py`: `test_selector_projects_a_pack_quantized_target_lm_head` — a `weight_packed` head through `DFlash2DraftModel.compute_candidates`. Fails on `main` with the `RuntimeError` above.
- `test/registered/unit/layers/quantization/test_compressed_tensors_lm_head.py`: `TestShouldApplyLmHeadQuantMethod` — a packed head is applied, an `UnquantizedLinearMethod` is still refused, and a stale ModelOpt method on a packed head is refused.

## Accuracy Tests

- After the fix the selector is captured: `DFLASH selector decode folded into the draft cuda graph (sampling_enabled=True)`.
- Local serving with the int4 head: 40-task tool-call test, 0 failures; DFlash2 acceptance length 4.06 vs 4.11 with the bf16 head (within noise); 128K positions compared position-by-position against the bf16 head: top-1 agreement 98.25% — the head quantization itself, not this change.
- The two CPU test files above and `test_modelopt_loader.py`'s lm_head guard cases pass locally; no public checkpoint with a pack-quantized head is available for an e2e CI case.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No hot-path change beyond the fix itself; not separately benchmarked.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations) — not applicable.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed) — accuracy above; no speed claim.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

Force-pushed a different approach after the first round, so the earlier two commits are gone; apologies for the churn.

The gate used `hasattr(lm_head, "weight")` as a proxy for "quantized head we can apply", which is the actual bug: the method owns its parameter name (`weight_packed` for WNA16, `qweight` for GGUF). Rather than adding `weight_packed` to the proxy and a guard for the ModelOpt branches, the branch now:

1. deletes the dead duplicate of the two helpers that the Qwen3.8 rebase (#35758) pasted back at the top of `logits_processor.py` (pure deletion, `git blame` confirms);
2. gates on the method only and keeps the `weight` reads inside the ModelOpt stale-method checks; `_compute_lm_head` requires `weight` before taking the helper's branch so the target logits path is unchanged for every head.

Net −55 lines in `logits_processor.py`. Tests: a `weight_packed` case at the DFLASH call site (`test_dflash_logits.py`, fails on `main` with the original `RuntimeError`) and gate unit tests. The PR description is updated to match.

Trimmed the PR to the fix itself: the dead-code deletion is out (I can send it separately), only the live definition of the helper is touched, and the tests are down to the cases that pin the behavior change (one at the DFLASH call site that fails on `main`, three for the gate). Net code change is +12/−5 in `logits_processor.py`; description updated. Sorry for the extra force-push — no human review had started yet.
This is the same gate #40883 changes (open since 09-23). That PR also covers NEXTN, which reads `lm_head.weight` in `get_embed_and_head`, so it may be worth looking at the two together.

### 🟡 Changes recommended Packed heads paired with stale ModelOpt methods can now raise `AttributeError` instead of being rejected safely.
1 open finding - [Prevent stale ModelOpt guards from dereferencing packed lm_head weights](#discussion_r4227471644) · New
What changed in this PR Extends quantized `lm_head` detection to support compressed-tensors WNA16 packed weights used by DFLASH and DSpark. **Changes:** - Accepts `weight_packed` heads in the quantization-method gate. - Adds CPU regression tests for packed, dense, missing-weight, and unquantized cases. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `python/​sglang/​srt/​layers/​logits_processor.py` | Broadens quantized-head detection. | | `test/​registered/​unit/​layers/​quantization/​test_compressed_tensors_lm_head.py` | Adds gate behavior tests. |
🧠 **Review effort:** Balanced --- 💡 Add a `code-review` agent skill or configure MCP servers for context-aware, tailored reviews. Learn more in the docs.

Allowing `weight_packed` through this gate introduces an exception path for the three ModelOpt methods below: their stale-method guards unconditionally read `lm_head.weight.dtype`. A packed head paired with a stale ModelOpt method now raises `AttributeError` instead of returning `False`, even though these guards exist specifically to reject mismatched runtime layouts. Track whether `weight` exists and reject ModelOpt methods before those dereferences (and cover the packed/stale combination in the regression tests).

Force-pushed a different approach after the first round, so the earlier two commits are gone; apologies for the churn.

The gate used `hasattr(lm_head, "weight")` as a proxy for "quantized head we can apply", which is the actual bug: the method owns its parameter name (`weight_packed` for WNA16, `qweight` for GGUF). Rather than adding `weight_packed` to the proxy and a guard for the ModelOpt branches, the branch now:

1. deletes the dead duplicate of the two helpers that the Qwen3.8 rebase (#35758) pasted back at the top of `logits_processor.py` (pure deletion, `git blame` confirms);
2. gates on the method only and keeps the `weight` reads inside the ModelOpt stale-method checks; `_compute_lm_head` requires `weight` before taking the helper's branch so the target logits path is unchanged for every head.

Net −55 lines in `logits_processor.py`. Tests: a `weight_packed` case at the DFLASH call site (`test_dflash_logits.py`, fails on `main` with the original `RuntimeError`) and gate unit tests. The PR description is updated to match.

Trimmed the PR to the fix itself: the dead-code deletion is out (I can send it separately), only the live definition of the helper is touched, and the tests are down to the cases that pin the behavior change (one at the DFLASH call site that fails on `main`, three for the gate).
